from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a housing construction report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the statistics cover, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing these statistics was released")
    housing_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    housing_completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Completions")
    units_under_construction: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted number of Units Under Construction at period end")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_records: list[MonthlyHousingRecord]
